description: Deterministically resolve a folder and set the default subtitle language on every CONVERTED video (POST /player?type=video). Pass language 'false' to clear the default. dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos. Note: videos lacking that subtitle simply won't show it.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

language.description: Subtitle language code to set as default (e.g. 'pt-BR'), or 'false' to clear

name: panda_action_set_default_subtitle_for_folder
title: Set Default Subtitle for Folder
